Stock generally trades with low price volatility

summary: Saudi Aramco Q2 2026 adjusted net income surged 33% YoY to $33.4B; free cash flow jumped 42% to $25.9B despite severe regional disruptions.
Upstream EBIT rose 14% to $50.9B on $108/barrel crude prices; downstream EBIT nearly doubled to $6.2B, reflecting integrated model strength.
Company maintains 2026 capex guidance at $50-55B; production capacity of 12M bpd intact, can reach max output within three weeks if needed.
Q3 production expected around 9.5M boe/day if Strait of Hormuz remains restricted; refining margins forecast to stay strong through H2 2026.
CEO Nasser cited 'biggest ever energy supply shock' removing 11M bpd; firm holds $60B cash with 6.2% gearing ratio and 22.1% ROACE.
